name: Poly Macro Oscillator 2
description: This algorithm is a polysynth where each voice is essentially a Plaits (the open source Plaits module by Émilie Gillet). Please refer to the section "Common polysynth features" above.
gui_description: The display shows the notes being played by the various voices. Note that Plaits voices never really end – in theory they decay forever.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: Chooses the synthesis model.

parameters.name: Coarse tune
parameters.description: Coarse tuning control.

parameters.name: Fine tune
parameters.description: Fine tuning control.

parameters.description: Sets the harmonics control.

parameters.name: Timbre
